enriched_activities.activity: Lying in bed watching YouTube videos on phone and winding down before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open YouTube app. Scroll through videos. Tap on video. Watch video. Adjust volume. Tap on another video. Watch video. Place phone on bedside table. Turn off phone. Pull blanket up. Turn off bedside lamp. Close eyes. Breathe deeply.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Daily stretching routine on the floor beside the bed
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to floor beside bed. Sit down on floor. Extend legs forward. Reach for toes. Hold stretch. Release. Spread legs. Lean forward. Hold stretch. Release. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Hot shower, shaving and morning hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Pick up razor. Apply shaving cream to face. Shave face. Rinse face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a breakfast that fits the medical dietary restriction, plus strong coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Crack eggs. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour boiling water into mug. Add coffee powder. Stir. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink coffee. Pick up plate and mug. Walk to sink. Rinse. Load dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Drive the EV to the psychology clinic
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up keys. Walk to EV. Unlock EV. Open door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start EV. Adjust mirrors. Shift gear. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Turn left. Turn right. Park at clinic. Turn off EV. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock EV. Walk to clinic entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Conducting in-person clinical psychology assessment and therapy sessions with clients
enriched_activities.desc: Sit in office chair. Greet client. Open client file. Ask assessment questions. Listen to client. Write notes. Discuss therapy goals. Provide therapy intervention. Assign homework. Schedule next session. Escort client to waiting room. Clean office. Prepare for next client.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a packed homemade lunch in the staff room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff room. Open bag. Take out lunch container. Open container. Pick up fork. Eat lunch. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Close container. Place container in bag. Throw away napkin. Walk out of staff room.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing client sessions and handling telehealth consultation calls and case notes
enriched_activities.desc: Conduct therapy session with client. Take notes. Escort client out. Make telehealth call. Open telehealth platform. Start video call. Greet client. Discuss issues. Provide advice. End call. Write summary. Type case notes on computer. Review files. Schedule appointments. Answer phone. Update calendar.

enriched_activities.activity: Drive the EV back home from the clinic
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to EV. Unlock EV. Open door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start EV. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Park at home. Turn off EV. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock EV. Walk to house.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing client notes and updating records on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Turn on study light. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open client management software. Read notes. Type updates. Save file. Close software. Turn off computer. Turn off study light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a dinner that respects the dietary restriction
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir. Add protein. Cook. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer to serving dish.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Scrape leftovers into trash. Rinse plate. Open dishwasher. Place plate in dishwasher. Place glass in dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a streaming series on the TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Open streaming app. Select series. Play episode. Sit on couch. Watch. Adjust volume. Pause. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return. Sit. Resume. Watch.

enriched_activities.activity: Working through an online professional development course on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Turn on light. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open browser. Log into course platform. Watch video lecture. Take notes. Complete quiz. Read article. Post in forum. Close browser. Turn off computer. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening shower and personal hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Streaming another episode while tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on TV. Open streaming app. Play episode. Pick up items from floor. Place on shelves. Fold blanket. Fluff pillows. Dust coffee table. Vacuum floor. Empty vacuum. Put vacuum away. Sit on couch. Watch.

enriched_activities.activity: Brewing herbal tea and wiping down the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Take mug. Place tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Steep tea. Remove tea bag. Wipe counters with cloth. Rinse cloth. Wring cloth. Hang cloth. Pick up mug. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening prayer and reflective journaling before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Kneel beside bed. Fold hands. Pray. Stand up. Sit on bed. Pick up journal. Pick up pen. Write. Close journal. Put journal on nightstand. Put pen on nightstand. Turn off bedside lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.
